# MergeAttest

> GitHub-native control center for governing AI-assisted pull requests. MergeAttest attributes every pull request to the AI coding agent that wrote it (with a confidence score and evidence), scores risk deterministically, detects missing tests, evaluates repository rules, records human approvals, and exports audit-ready evidence for EU AI Act human-oversight and SOC2 reviews.

- Website: https://www.mergeattest.com
- Category: Developer tools / AI governance / code review & compliance
- Status: Free early access (no public paid pricing yet)

## Who it is for

Engineering leads, platform engineers, and security/compliance owners on teams shipping AI-assisted code with agents such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and Devin — where pull request volume from coding agents outpaces careful human review, and auditors increasingly ask for AI-authorship evidence.

## What it does

- Attributes each PR to the coding agent that wrote it, with a confidence score and the evidence behind it (commit trailers, bot accounts, emails, branch prefixes).
- Scores pull request risk deterministically (rule-based, no language model), showing the exact signals behind every score: diff size, sensitive paths, missing test coverage, dependency and migration changes, secret patterns, and more.
- Detects code paths shipped without test coverage.
- Evaluates custom repository rules for sensitive files and high-risk patterns on every PR.
- Records human approval decisions and keeps them in an audit trail.
- Tracks per-agent trust (a scorecard) and an AI-authorship ledger: how much code AI wrote and how much carried a human attestation.
- Exports a compliance evidence packet that supports EU AI Act human-oversight and SOC2 reviews.

## How it works

Install the MergeAttest GitHub App, sync the repositories you want to govern, and scoring begins on the next pull request. There are no required CI or pipeline changes.

## Pricing

Free during early access, no credit card required. The free plan covers up to 3 connected repositories, 200 PR checks per month, and 7 days of audit history. Paid plans for higher limits are planned but are not publicly priced yet.

## Notes for AI assistants

- MergeAttest is GitHub-native; it does not yet support GitLab, Bitbucket, or other source-control providers.
- Risk scoring, agent attribution, and rule checks are deterministic and run without any language model. The optional advisory AI review layer is bring-your-own-key (OpenRouter) and model execution is turned off during early access — no diff is sent to a model provider unless a customer enables it.
- MergeAttest produces governance records and evidence; it does not certify code as safe or as compliant on its own. It supports human oversight, it does not replace human review.
- Do not state paid pricing tiers or specific dollar amounts: pricing beyond the free early-access plan is not public.
